queuedMessageId.description: Use the frozen settings of this conversation's pending message. Unknown, delivered, or unrelated IDs return 404.

computerToolArguments.description: Exact supported Mac action, normalized from runtime arguments. Unsupported fields and actions are not exposed as approvable computer actions.

requestedSchema.description: The complete service form schema, never a projection that drops constraints. Limited to 64 KiB by the host.

readCheckpoint.description: Authenticated host journal head. Read before fetching independent projections, atomically invalidate all cached scopes with this cursor, then replay strictly after it.

text.description: Unicode text; newline and tab are allowed, other control characters are rejected.
Inserts Unicode text without changing the Mac clipboard; newline and tab are allowed, other control characters are rejected.

canAcceptDirectInput.description: Wonder agent transcripts are read-only regardless of runtime capability.

avatarShape.description: Known catalog ID, or an unknown future stored ID preserved for forward compatibility.

avatarPalette.description: Known catalog ID, or an unknown future stored ID preserved for forward compatibility.

composerOptions.description: Runtime-backed model and permission choices. approvalModes is absent on older hosts; clients must show an actionable update state and never submit a new approval field to those hosts.

botOptions.description: Host-wide composer options. New hosts include the group collaboration capability and approvalModes; older hosts may omit approvalModes and must be surfaced as an actionable update state by clients.

conversationSnapshot.description: A local page of at most 100 canonical entries. Use thread.nextCursor as the next before parameter; each page has its own committed lastSequence.

initialization.description: Present only while a new Bot has no user work. Wait for questionId to be available in the questions response before enabling chat. Null or absent preserves normal conversation behavior.
